title: Clo User Summit 2024: New York City 🚖
description:
Watch the highlights from our 🗽 2024 CLO NY User Summit 🍎! Thanks to all our speakers, partners, staff & most of all, our attendees - many of whom traveled a long way to be with us! We hope this year's Summit inspired you to continue to invest in each other as we look forward to weaving the future of fashion, together with you. Comment below if you spot yourself in the video!

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord- 

---

transcript: The reason we are having this user summit today is we want to bring enterprise clients as well as individual users or just overall general users that loves Clo, that utilizes Clo. We want to bring them all together so they can see what we have in our rolemask. We want them to utilize Clo in a way that they might never did it before. My highlight from this event was meeting other people in different companies but in the same industry and sharing experiences. Main takeaway from this event is this incredible collaboration amongst all the companies that are using Clo and the incredible future possibilities with what 3D and Clo can do for the industry. So we're just excited to be here and be surrounded by so many incredible people who are nerdy in the same ways that we are. But again, the beauty of a Cottage container is that we are the people who provide what our clients can expect. And that mission is in this video here. Thank you. I can do whatever I want. And if I don't succeed make sure you do to the optimist, all right. I believe a bunch and lunch Thanks for watching!
markdown_content: ## Clo User Summit 2024: Overview and Key Highlights This section covers the purpose and key takeaways of the Clo User Summit 2024, focusing on enterprise and individual users, collaboration, and future possibilities within the 3D and Clo technology ecosystem. The Clo User Summit 2024 was organized to bring together a diverse group of users, including enterprise clients and general users who utilize Clo software. The event aimed to showcase new capabilities within the Clo platform, encouraging attendees to explore features and workflows they might not have used previously. A major highlight of the summit was the opportunity for participants from different companies but within the same industry to network and share their experiences. This cross-company collaboration emphasized the strong community that has formed around Clo and highlighted the potential for future innovation by integrating 3D technologies with Clo's platform. The summit underscored the mission of Clo’s team as creators and enablers of advanced 3D design tools, reflecting their commitment to delivering solutions that exceed client expectations. The event fostered a sense of shared enthusiasm among attendees, described as a gathering of like-minded "nerds," all passionate about driving the industry forward through technology. --- ## Community Collaboration and Industry Impact This section discusses the collaborative culture fostered at the Clo User Summit and the broader implications for the 3D design and apparel industries. A key takeaway from the summit was the demonstration of incredible collaboration across different companies using Clo. Participants engaged in meaningful discussions about how 3D technology can revolutionize their workflows and product development processes. The event provided a platform to envision new possibilities enabled by combining Clo’s 3D design capabilities with industry-specific needs. The collaborative atmosphere highlighted the importance of community in advancing technology adoption and innovation. By exchanging insights and sharing best practices, users contribute to a collective knowledge base that benefits all stakeholders. The summit also reinforced Clo's role as a central hub for industry collaboration, facilitating connections that drive progress in digital fashion and apparel design. --- ## Clo’s Mission and Vision for the Future This section outlines Clo’s strategic mission and vision as presented at the summit, focusing on client expectations and ongoing innovation in 3D design. Clo positions itself as a pioneer in providing sophisticated 3D design solutions tailored to the needs of apparel brands and manufacturers. The company’s mission is to empower clients with tools that enhance creativity, efficiency, and product accuracy. At the summit, Clo emphasized their commitment to continuous innovation, aiming to push the boundaries of what 3D technology can achieve in the fashion industry. They envision a future where their platform enables seamless integration of digital design and real-world production, fostering sustainability and reducing time-to-market. The team’s optimistic outlook was reflected in their engagement with users, encouraging experimentation and learning to maximize the value derived from Clo’s technology. --- ## Summary The Clo User Summit 2024 served as a collaborative platform for users across industries to explore and expand their use of Clo’s 3D design software. Key themes included community collaboration, innovation in digital apparel design, and the company’s mission to empower clients with cutting-edge tools. The event highlighted the vibrant user community and the promising future of 3D technology integration within the fashion industry.
